About_Description: Compiles your games' shaders into the graphics driver's cache ahead of time, so they don't stutter the first time you play them.
About_DisclaimerText: SCSKiller is provided as is, without warranty. It checks each game for anti-cheat before adding its recorder, but that check can miss one. You use it at your own risk, and its authors are not responsible for bans, crashes or lost data.

Settings_AntiCheatDialog_Content:
For one session, SCSKiller puts its recorder (a d3d12.dll) next to the game's exe.

Games with anti-cheat can treat the recorder as cheating and ban your account, during the session or later. No game is known to be safe.

SCSKiller removes every file it places when the game exits, or after a crash at your next logon.

Enabling the recorder in these games is at your own risk. SCSKiller isn't responsible for bans.
Settings_RemoveRecorders_Body: SCSKiller removes its recorder from every game, then quits. Close your games first: a game that's running keeps its recorder. Recording resumes when SCSKiller starts again.

Settings_ConfirmLimitBody:
This is a global {0} driver setting: it applies to every game on this PC, not only the ones SCSKiller compiles, and stays until you change it. Windows will ask for administrator permission.

Raising it deletes nothing. Lowering it below what is used now makes the driver delete older entries, and those games stutter again. You can switch back to the driver default here at any time.

Detail_PartlyWhy_DriverRefused: SCSKiller compiled this game, but the graphics driver refused a large part of it. This happens when the driver or {0} can't build pipelines the way the game does. The refused ones are built by the game the first time it needs them, which is when they can stutter. SCSKiller compiles them again after a driver update.
Detail_PartlyWhy_FilesCantBuild: SCSKiller compiled this game, but it couldn't build a large part of it from the game's files. The game builds those itself the first time it needs them, which is when they can stutter.
Detail_PartlyWhy_Generic: SCSKiller compiled this game, but a large part of it couldn't be compiled. The game builds those itself the first time it needs them, which is when they can stutter. SCSKiller compiles them again after a driver update.
Detail_MaxCompileWhy: Compiles every combination of this game's shaders, not just each one once. It takes longer and uses more disk space, but potentially fewer shaders compile while you play. Seems to help most on AMD.
Detail_Dialog_ClearRecordingBody:
The recorded pipelines are removed. They're compiled again only if the game creates them again while recording, and the compile plan goes back to what the game's files give.

The recorder itself stays in, and the game's files aren't touched.

Intro_Bullet_Graphics: Don't change graphics settings between the two runs.
Intro_Bullet_Deleted: Your current compile for this game is deleted, it's compiled again in step 2.
Intro_Bullet_D3D11: A small d3d11.dll goes next to the game for this recording only, then it's removed.
Intro_Bullet_Frames: Frame times stay on this PC. With sharing on, the usual anonymous hashes are sent.
Ba_Dialog_RecordAgainContent: SCSKiller clears the caches and compiles again first, so the new run isn't helped by the last one. Then play the same save again.
Ba_Dialog_CancelTitle: Cancel the before and after recording?
Ba_Dialog_CancelContent: Its shader caches were cleared, so the game stutters until it's compiled again.
Reason_TimedOut: couldn't be read in time, retried at the next scan
Reason_NotChecked: not checked yet: open it to check
Reason_RtToCompile: ray tracing shaders are still to compile
Reason_LauncherClears: start it once from Steam, then compile: its launcher clears the shader cache at the first start of a new install or season
Reason_PlanCheckFailed: SCSKiller couldn't update this game's plan in the background. A compile will update it
Reason_MissesGame: the compile didn't reach this game's cache: the game uses another driver-cache key
Reason_TrimmedPart: part of this game's compiled shader cache is gone, compile again
Reason_PlanGrew: This plan is much larger than your last compile of this game.
Reason_AftermathRetry: the next compile starts NVIDIA Aftermath as the game does
Reason_AftermathLost: NVIDIA Aftermath didn't help the last compile, the next one runs without it
Reason_D3DSCachePending: the compiled pipelines go into the game's cache when the game exits or SCSKiller starts
Reason_D3DSCacheDamaged: the compile's Windows shader cache was damaged, so compile it again
Reason_BootPrecompiles: builds its shaders at the main menu. In-game stutter isn't from shader compilation
Reason_ProtonNotReady: pick a Proton in its Properties, Compatibility
Reason_NoProton: Steam runs it without Proton: pick a Proton in its Properties, Compatibility
Reason_Dx9Amd: runs on DirectX 9: compiling it waits for SCSKiller's DirectX 9 compile on AMD
Detail_BaTip_StartAsUsual: Start {0} as usual: SCSKiller sees it start
Detail_Report_Choice_Better: Shader compilation stutter is better, but some stutter remains.
Detail_Report_Choice_NoHelp: The game compiled, but it did not help with the stutter.
Detail_Report_Choice_Worse: The game runs worse than before compiling.
Detail_Report_Choice_NotCompiled: The game could not be compiled.
Detail_Report_Choice_NoStutterBefore: The game had no shader compilation stutter before compiling either.
Compat_WhatIsSent_Windows: Sent with the rating: your CPU model, GPU model, driver version, Windows version, and what SCSKiller compiled for this game. Nothing else.
Compat_WhatIsSent_Linux: Sent with the rating: your CPU model, GPU model, driver version, Linux kernel version, the game's Proton version, and what SCSKiller compiled for this game. Nothing else.
Compat_WhyNot_NoBuild: SCSKiller can't tell which version of this game is installed.
Compat_WhyNot_Vendor: Ratings are for NVIDIA and AMD GPUs.
Compat_WhyNot_NotWarmed: Compile the game and play it once to rate how it ran.
Compat_WhyNot_PlayOnce: Play the game once since it compiled to rate how it ran.
Detail_Dialog_ClearCache_Steam: Steam's Shader Pre-Caching files for it go too, and Steam processes them again.
Detail_Dialog_ClearCache_AntiCheat: Anti-cheat game: only the driver cache is cleared.
Detail_Dialog_ClearCache_NothingCleared: Nothing was cleared: no shader-cache files of this game were found.
Detail_Dialog_ClearRecording_NothingClea: Nothing was cleared: no recording of this game was found.
Detail_ReportWindow_ReportMissing: The report isn't there anymore: start over.
Report_CopiedDiscord: Image and text copied: paste them in Discord
Report_PressCtrlV: Press Ctrl+V in the post to add it.
Library_NoGames_Linux_Steam: SCSKiller lists the Windows games you installed with Steam, Heroic or Lutris, and the ones you added to Steam with Proton.
Library_NoGames_Linux_NoSteam: SCSKiller lists the Windows games of Steam, Heroic and Lutris.
Library_AddGames_Note_Linux: To add another Windows game, use Add a Non-Steam Game in Steam. SCSKiller lists it at the next scan.
Library_NoGames_MacOS: Finding and compiling games isn't available on macOS yet.
